answer: Divergent-Challenge Liveness Test: each identity must periodically answer a random live challenge whose correct response depends on its private history (a fable of its past actions). Clones sharing one memory produce identical answers and fail when asked for distinct, time-stamped divergences. A sparrow-class bot farm can copy keys but not independent histories. Attackers pay one real interaction stream per identity; forged ivory records collapse under cross-checks, making replication cost linear in identities.
